payload.artist_html: L. Xing, K. Niu & S. E. Evans
payload.credit_html: "A new polyglyphanodontian lizard with a complete lower temporal bar from the Upper Cretaceous of southern China" See also "A new polyglyphanodontian lizard from the Upper Cretaceous of southern China implies a complex evolutionary history of the clade"
payload.description_html: Map of China showing the localities for polyglyphanodontian lizards in Ganzhou Basin, China. Tianyusaurus is known from localities in Henan and Jianxi provinces (marked on map of China, but not included in blowup). Caninosaurus ganzhouensis, Xenodontolacerta fangi, and Yechilacerta yingliangia are known from Jianxi Province; enlargement shows the locality from which the holotypes of C. ganzhouensis, X. fangi, and Y. yingliangia are known (site 2), and the locality of the second Y. yingliangia specimen (site 1).
